latest_release.name: Synaplan v5.8.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore(release): install 5.7.2 in new deployments by @synaplan-release-tagger[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3061
* fix: keep the pickup sweep cutoff inside the clock second by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3060
* chore(deps): update qa & dev tools by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3059
* chore(deps): update dependency web-token/jwt-library to v4.2.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3045
* feat: add Claude Fable 5.2 by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3069
* refactor(ai): decode provider streams incrementally by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3039
* feat(runtime): add a stream pump that stays off by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3040
* fix(ai): keep streamed text when a chunk also fails by @orgaralf in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3071
* chore(deps): update ollama/ollama:latest docker digest to 910d0d8 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3067
* chore(deps): update dependency @cloudflare/workers-types to v5.20261107.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3068
* chore(deps): update collabora/code docker tag to v26.04.6.1.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3072
* fix(deps): update module golang.org/x/sys to v0.50.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3063
* feat(platform-links): cloud calls use person tokens by @dschmidt in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3056
* feat(platform-links): sign notifications as JWTs by @dschmidt in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3062
* chore(deps): update redis:8.10-alpine docker digest to 71885d8 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3076
* feat(platform-links): configure a cloud from environment variables by @dschmidt in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3064
* test(auth): every entry point against every account status by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3074
* test(e2e): password reset and the SSO-only login page by @cristiangrxs in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3077
* feat(oauth): Synaplan as OAuth2 server for clouds by @dschmidt in https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/pull/3066


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/metadist/synaplan/compare/v5.7.2...v5.8.0
